## Findings refused

- U1–U2 `l`/`i`: Meged, Orusud, qarin "nations" kept (Ming 城名/種名/邦; glossary marks qarin sense uncertain, said in the note).
- U3: the sentence stays tentative with (?); no better reading is derivable from the Ming 金牽胷 退 扯着 分離的 alone.
- U5: "were put on their horses" for morilaγdaba kept (Ming 被上馬子, passive); the note explains.
- U13: doubtful sentence left as drafted; the note says so.
- U17/U26 and U28/U33 speech boundaries: the drafter's closing of Ögödei's speech at medetügei (Shiratori's mark at ügülejü is read as a slip) accepted.
- U19 "to an elder man's face" (Ming 胷前裏) kept.
- U22 "our own kin" kept (bidan-u uruγ-tur).
- U41 "make them die deep" kept as a literal rendering of Ming 敎死 深; the note admits the idiom is unknown.
- U38 "mill-like fury" kept; aγ̇ur (Ming 碓) is glossed as "pounding-mill" in the glossary, the figure is flagged.
- U44 "ram's hoof" kept (glossary: ešige-jin "young ram"; Ming 羖 simply "ram").
- Morph glosses carrying earlier-part Ming (keġer [曠野], üile [勾當], daγ̇uli- [擄]) left: the glosser's `__broaden__` handles the glossary entries; the Ming for this occurrence is in the notes.
